title: VAMS read-only Postgres connector
note: branch lane/vams-postgres-readonly (worktree cadre-wtPG). SELECT-only DB access for per-project VAMS data with no JSON endpoint; schema read from the Django source, psycopg bundled in the sidecar. Read-only DB role credential is in hand — actively verifying live queries against the real database.

title: Model layer
note: branch lane/model-layer (worktree cadre-wtMODEL). Chat runs on the selected brain (streaming), Cadre-managed local model load/unload (LM Studio without its own UI), workload→brain assignment across local + cloud with fallback chains — currently closing Ollama-parity gaps and building out richer LLM-map usage data.

title: Email auto-organization
note: branch lane/email-auto-organize (worktree cadre-wtORG). Making §22 real: learn folder taxonomy, spam/junk detection, auto-file with a learn→suggest→auto trust ladder, logged + reversible, local-model driven.

title: VAMS knowledge/query tools
note: Model answers any VAMS question via read-only query tools. Waiting on the Postgres connector + model layer to land.

title: Cross-source COO insights
note: COO insight + improvement suggestions on the dashboard, drawn across VAMS + email + Mattermost. Waiting on the data + model layers, and now on the knowledge graph spine.

title: Dashboard drill-down
note: Drill-down depth on any dashboard field. Waiting on the data + model layers.

title: Mattermost persistence + sync
note: Cadre currently fetches Mattermost live and stores nothing. Needs a sync-and-persist pipeline (like the email full-sync) so Mattermost threads are searchable and can feed the knowledge graph.

title: Wire knowledge ingestion triggers (email + Mattermost → graph)
note: Connect the email and Mattermost pipelines into the knowledge-graph ingestion processors so new messages/threads flow into the graph automatically, not just on manual runs.

title: Knowledge graph + Mattermost ingestion — built & tested
note: branch lane/knowledge-graph, 442 backend tests green. Unified cross-source entity graph (email + Mattermost + VAMS) with record-code linking + ingestion processors, built and tested. Pending merge in the next release batch — not yet user-visible. Unblocks the two queued Mattermost-persistence/ingestion-trigger items above.

title: Wave-2 COO intelligence architecture — spec delivered
note: Design/spec lane complete (scratchpad/wave2-coo-intelligence-spec.md): designed the VAMS knowledge/query-tool layer, the cross-source (VAMS+email+Mattermost) COO insight engine, and dashboard drill-down. Unblocked the Email auto-organization and Knowledge graph build lanes.
